overview: This 293-page file gathers 1945–46 reports on Japanese espionage and propaganda in China. Most pages investigate alleged collaboration by Filipinos in wartime Shanghai, often through conflicting testimony and documentary evidence. Later reports detail a Japanese intelligence network in South China, post-surrender activity, and inquiries into Hajimu Masuda’s citizenship.
interest: The contested Shanghai dossiers and detailed intelligence-network reports let historians compare accusations, personal defenses, and operational records.
